description:
Send a test event to verify a webhook is working. Returns the HTTP status code and response time.

Pass agent_id to test that agent's webhook. Omit to test the project-level webhook.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to test that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

name: test_webhook

outputSchema.description: The result of sending a test event to the webhook.

error.description: Error message if the test failed, or null.

responseMs.description: Your endpoint's response time in ms, or null.

statusCode.description: HTTP status your endpoint returned, or null.

success.description: Whether the test event was delivered.

title: Test Webhook
